_notes: Drug class lists shared by the static-data checks (drug-disease, stack patterns). Each class lists its generic and brand names explicitly; nothing is inferred. Each list was checked on the date in its `verifiedOn` field against the 2023 AGS Beers Criteria where the paper lists the drugs, and against NLM RxClass where the paper only names the class; see docs/DATA_VERIFICATION.md. Several lists are selections rather than complete classes. A drug whose name alone cannot separate a flagged form from an unflagged one is left out on purpose.

sources: American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2023;71(7):2052-2081. Full text read from PubMed Central (author manuscript): https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12478568/
NLM RxNorm and RxClass (https://rxnav.nlm.nih.gov/) for brand-name ingredients and for membership of classes the paper names without listing drugs.
verification.rule: Matchers ignore any entry whose `verified` value is not "confirmed" or "corrected".

antidepressants-tca-ssri-snri.verificationNote: The paper names the classes (TCAs, SSRIs, SNRIs) without listing members. Each drug here is classed as a tricyclic antidepressant, SSRI or SNRI in RxClass. This is a selection, not the complete classes; doxepin is left out.

antiepileptics.verificationNote: The paper names the class without listing members. Each drug is an antiepileptic in RxClass, except gabapentin and pregabalin, which ATC now classes as gabapentinoids and which Table 5 explicitly counts among antiepileptics. This is a selection, not the complete class.
